reviewed_discrepancies.syntax_form: parenthesized named generator function expression invoked immediately inside an anonymous async callback
reviewed_discrepancies.reason: The pinned source contains this genuine lexically named function. TreeSitterTool omits it from named-function indexing because the frozen SDK syntax mapping covers function_declaration/function_signature/generator_function_declaration but omits function_expression/generator_function. This is a syntax coverage gap in the broad named-function objective. It is not a failed TypeScript parse, a line-number discrepancy, a fabricated compiler fact, or a reference/call inference gap. The graph reports succeeded for its currently implemented profile, so profile-scoped success must not be generalized to all named functions.
reviewed_discrepancies.recommended_tracking: Record the coverage defect explicitly and add named ordinary/generator function-expression conformance cases in a separate implementation iteration. Freeze parser throughout this pilot.
